_comment: Windows: strata-ds41.json with the engine run directly (ds41-engine.sh's settings moved into env; no flock/systemd-run). Paths: D:\models\dsv41-gsq (the HF repo's files as downloaded, joined V41-GSQ.gguf; vocab/merges/token_type are the tokenizer dir) and D:\models\dsv41-engram-src (the HF checkpoint's two Engram shards + index, read in place on NTFS). --engram takes ';' between folders on Windows. Tuned on an RTX 3090 + Ryzen 7 5800X + 128 GB DDR4 (3 greedy reps x prose/code/agent, quiet disk): --arena-gib 72 (+15%; 80 no better) and STRATA_TIER_BATCH_PCIE 0.75 (+2%, code +6%); DSpark kept at depth 4 / conf 0.6 (off = prose +12%, code -14%). Edit the paths for your machine (docs/WINDOWS.md).
